subject: Private VPC / On-Prem architecture review
messages_1_body:
Hi Paul,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — it was great to learn more about FinLytics' requirements and constraints. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Primary goals: host inference on customer-managed infrastructure for PII-sensitive workflows, maintain sub-100ms median latency for key endpoints, and retain audit logs for 7 years.
- Constraints: customer-managed KMS, strict inbound firewall rules, occasional air-gapped maintenance windows, and M&E (monitoring & export) requirements for internal audit.

As discussed, next step is a technical architecture review (Private/VPC/on-prem) with your infra/SRE and our Solutions Engineering team so we can:
  1) walk through a proposed topology (peering, private link, or dedicated connection),
  2) map network & firewall requirements,
  3) validate KMS/HSM integration options and logging/audit flow, and
  4) flag any blockers for an on-prem package.

Proposed slots next week: 
- Tue 2027-08-03 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-08-04 14:00-15:00 PT
- Thu 2027-08-05 09:00-10:00 PT

Please let me know which slot works for your team and who from FinLytics will join (network/SRE, security/KMS owner). Also if you can share a basic network diagram and any compliance checklist items ahead of time that’ll help us tailor the agenda.

Attaching our Private/VPC one-pager and SOC2 summary for reference.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf
messages_2_subject: Re: Private VPC / On-Prem architecture review
messages_2_body:
Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. We’re definitely interested in moving forward with the architecture review. Our SRE lead (Samantha Lee) and our security/KMS owner (Pauline Gomez) should join the call. 

Tue 08/03 at 10:00 PT works for us. Can you confirm whether your SE will cover KMS integrations (we use an HSM-backed key provider) and whether you have an on-prem checklist for required egress/inbound ports?

I’ll ask IT to produce a high-level network diagram (will try to get that to you by EOD Monday). We’ll also need your SOC2 summary and anything you can share on data retention/audit logs.

Thanks,
Paul Turner
Head of Platform Engineering | FinLytics
paul.turner@finlytics.com | +1 617-555-0189
messages_3_subject: Re: Private VPC / On-Prem architecture review — SE availability
messages_3_body:
Looping in from SE — hi Paul, thanks for the context and confirm on Tue 08/03 10:00 PT. I’ll be the Redwood SE on the call and will bring our solutions architect (Vikram) to cover KMS/HSM integration patterns, auth flows, and latency tradeoffs.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) introductions & goals (5m)
2) current infra overview from FinLytics (10m)
3) proposed topology options (peering vs private link vs dedicated connection) (15m)
4) KMS/HSM integration and audit/logging details (10m)
5) next steps & success criteria (5m)

I’ve attached an internal architecture diagram we reference — we’ll refine after your diagram. Can you confirm Samantha and Pauline will be on the invite? Also please flag any compliance docs you want covered (SOC2 sections, retention policies).

Thanks — rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
 rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: architecture-diagram.png
